items.title: Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) exceeds Q3 expectations but guidance misses consensus
items.summary: Analog chipmaker Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q2 2027) results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 42.2% year on year to $1.62 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.61 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.4% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.97 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
